text: Senate Concurrent Resolution 103 - Introduced SENATE CONCURRENT RESOLUTION NO. 103 BY KLIMESH A Concurrent Resolution to provide for the business 1 of the first extraordinary session of the 2026 2 legislative session. 3 WHEREAS, Governor Kim Reynolds has convened an 4 extraordinary session of the Ninety-first General 5 Assembly on Friday, October 2, 2026; NOW THEREFORE, 6 BE IT RESOLVED BY THE SENATE, THE HOUSE OF 7 REPRESENTATIVES CONCURRING, That pursuant to Joint Rule 8 3, the business of the first extraordinary session of 9 the 2026 legislative session shall be limited to the 10 consideration of a bill for an Act relating to the 11 major economic growth attraction program and including 12 effective date provisions; and any other resolutions 13 that either chamber may adopt. 14 -1- LSB 6977XS (4) 91 jm/jh 1/ 1
